headline: Get Hexxin
title: How to Get Hexxin | Catch It Or Evolve It | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Hexxin is the dark and grass final form of the Hummin line. You can catch a wild one in The Mistwoods at levels thirty five to thirty seven, with a catch rate of about twenty eight percent. Or evolve Hummin at level eighteen. Hummin can also become Tuckin at the same level, so pick your branch on purpose. Which Hummin form do you want? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Hexxin can be caught in The Mistwoods at levels 35 to 37, or evolved from Hummin at level 18. Hummin can also become Tuckin.
